text:
Nina (CS): Quick ping: BrightBridge is hitting 429s in onboarding when calling embeddings from serverless workers. They say ~5 concurrent cold starts. Using js-sdk v1.2.0 and demo ephemeral tokens. Can we triage?

Ethan (SDK): Likely preflight/auth fanout from per-activation client creation. Can you paste logs?

Nina (CS): Logs: 
```
2025-02-03T11:05:10Z coldstart
2025-02-03T11:05:10Z auth: ephemeral -> 200
2025-02-03T11:05:10Z prefetch: /v1/prefetch -> 200
2025-02-03T11:05:11Z embeddings call -> 429 Too Many Requests
```

Raj (SE): Region? account id? ops-bot can show window settings.

Nina (CS): Region eu-central-1, account brightbridge-staging.

ops-bot: Account windows: embeddings_prefetch=3 req/s. demo_tokens=true.

Ethan (SDK): Immediate fixes: (1) reuse one SDK client per container (avoid one-per-invocation); (2) upgrade to js-sdk v1.3.1 which coalesces prefetch; (3) add randomized 0-300ms coldstart jitter. For testing only: set REDWOOD_SKIP_PREFETCH=true.

Raj (SE): Can we apply a short bump to their embeddings_prefetch?

ops-bot: Temporary bump possible with CS+Eng approval. Specify rate and duration.

Nina (CS): Requesting 8 req/s for 20m while they validate upgrade.

Raj (SE): Ack. Applying now.

ops-bot: Change applied: embeddings_prefetch=8 req/s for brightbridge-staging for 20m.

Nina (CS): Shared a minimal repro and upgrade snippet with customer. They upgraded to v1.3.1 and switched to client reuse. After 5 minutes the 429s stopped during their ramp. Will monitor 30m then close. Thanks all :thumbsup:
